text: The agent recommends coding the Ampliqo Analytics invoice to account 6350 (Software Subscriptions), cost centre CC9130, with 95% confidence. This matches recent API usage overage invoices from Ledgerly Technologies, Vantix Analytics and Nimbusly Cloud, all coded to 6350. $30,252.32 of SEP-26 service was not accrued at close and lands in October, which is above the $25,000 materiality threshold, so it has been reported to Record-to-Report as out-of-period expense, and the invoice is awaiting confirmation from Amara Torres (Director).
